items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this flaw, which has a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (APSB25-88)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API. Adobe has released a hotfix (VULN-32437-2-4-X-patch) to remediate this issue.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This security update addresses several critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. If unpatched, these issues could allow attackers to bypass security features, escalate privileges, read sensitive files, and cause application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-26
items.summary: This update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service.
